page.title: Leads & Enquiries
page.body:
Automated Lead Capture & Conversion

Our infrastructure ensures that no opportunity slips through the cracks. The moment an inquiry is made, all captured leads are automatically converted into contacts within your Smart CRM, ready to be seamlessly assigned to a staff member and added to your active sales pipeline.

The Three Strategic Lead Streams

PropertyList automatically segments your incoming opportunities based on their origin, allowing you to tailor your follow-up strategy:

MLS LEADS

Connect with qualified clients and co-broking opportunities referred directly by fellow verified agents operating on the collaborative MLS platform.

MICROSITE LEADS

Capture enquiries from direct potential clients through your free Branded MicroSite. When you share your custom property URL, the built-in lead capture form funnels interested buyers directly to your dashboard.

PORTAL LEADS

Expand your reach to the consumer market. The PropertyList public property portal acts as a direct lead generation engine, delivering highly qualified direct consumer leads right to you.

Centralised Command Center

No matter where they come from - whether a co-broking agent or a direct public buyer - all your leads are conveniently collected in one secure place for easy management, rapid follow-up, and comprehensive pipeline overview.
This comprehensive approach ensures a steady stream of leads is managed effortlessly, allowing you to focus your energy on what you do best - converting inquiries into happy clients and closed deals.
Happy Hunting!
